svg.title: How the GEAR training set grows
svg.desc: Three consecutive rounds for a fixed training image, goal and start. Each round labels the current path, adds a new bank, fits on all accumulated banks and advances the path with an energy check. The lower panels show full-dataset training and the measured mean path energy across all 14 aggregation rounds.
